entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A Consulate minister and inspector who plans the counterattack on the Aether Hub by exploiting the Gatewatch's weaknesses and later arrests Baral.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: The metal-armed Special Grand Consul with crimson tattoos that remind him of a debt, who screams at staff and sends Baral after the Nalaars.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: A scarred Consulate Chief of Compliance who killed Kiran Nalaar, imprisoned Pia and torments Chandra to draw her away from the Hub.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker who is haunted by guilt, fights Baral and nearly detonates herself before Nissa calms her.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who defends the Hub, fights a Gearhulk from inside and carries Chandra afterward.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker who protects Chandra, fights with a sword formed from her staff, and talks her out of destroying herself.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker who destroys a greenwood Gearhulk.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage who is away aiding Kari Zev.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A lifecrafter who is struck by thopter lightning and left unconscious but alive.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's mother and a renegade leader who embraces her after the battle.

entities.name: Kiran Nalaar
entities.description: Chandra's father, killed by Baral twelve years earlier.

entities.name: Shadowblayde
entities.description: A dark-skinned elf renegade who runs communications with mechanical butterflies and rescues Gideon from a wrecked Gearhulk.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: An aetherborn criminal mastermind at the renegades' top deck planning.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: A sky pirate allied with the renegades with Jace.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An inventor among the renegade leaders at the Hub.

entities.name: Consul Kambal
entities.description: A Consul who assured Baan the Hub was safe from usurpation.

entities.name: Hixus
entities.description: A mentor whose advice about choosing between protecting and needing to protect Gideon recalls.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group supporting the renegades.

entities.name: The Consulate
entities.description: The government attacking the renegades with Gearhulks and inspectors.

entities.name: The Renegades
entities.description: Rebels holding the Aether Hub.

entities.name: The Inspectors
entities.description: Faceless armored Consulate enforcers.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: The city on Kaladesh in civil war.

entities.name: The Aether Hub
entities.description: The vital aether distribution center the renegades hold.

entities.name: Weldfast
entities.description: Solidly renegade territory where the Heart of Kiran retreats.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Chandra's home plane.

entities.name: Regatha
entities.description: Plane where the Purifying Fire showed Chandra her guilt.

entities.name: Skysovereign
entities.description: The Consulate dreadnought serving as Tezzeret's command deck.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: The renegade airship that rises beside the Hub and later hangs over Weldfast.

entities.name: Gearhulks
entities.description: Giant Consulate war machines, five in number, deployed against the renegade lines.

entities.name: Purifying Fire
entities.description: A Regatha fire that demanded acceptance of responsibility from Chandra.

events.summary: On Skysovereign, Tezzeret screams at an orderly and Baan challenges the Grand Consul's tactics privately.
events.quote: I acknowledge the effectiveness of your harangues at keeping this crew aligned and attentive. I, however, am...unimpressed.

events.summary: Baan lays out a pincer-and-airborne plan to retake the Aether Hub, exploiting the Gatewatch's divided leadership and Chandra's rashness.
events.quote: Transports loaded with Inspectors.

events.summary: Tezzeret orders Baral to lure the Nalaars and their friends away from the Hub, adding Baan to Baral's squad.
events.quote: Annoy the Nalaars. Lure them away from the Aether Hub.

events.summary: Chandra, sleepless and troubled, looks over Ghirapur from the Hub and misses her mother.
events.quote: Now she's back, somewhere up above me, just a little bit away.

events.summary: Gideon comforts Chandra, and they recall how they met and the Purifying Fire; Chandra confesses guilt over the Sanctum of Stars and asks for a hug.
events.quote: He's standing with arms wide, smiling.

events.summary: Nissa finds Chandra in Gideon's arms, and Chandra awkwardly tries to explain.
events.quote: Nissa sets a plate of eggplant and potato curry on one of the benches

events.summary: Baral's amplified voice taunts Chandra about her father's death and her mother's imprisonment, goading her into running out; Nissa follows.
events.quote: Have you told your friends the story? About how you got daddy killed?

events.summary: Gideon, torn, asks Nissa to keep Chandra safe and returns to the Hub's defenses.
events.quote: "Keep her safe."

events.summary: Baral leads Chandra through old stone streets toward a trap.
events.quote: "All that time your mother suffered . Thinking you were dead ."

events.summary: Chandra turns the thorn wall into a fire and injures her arm; Nissa's vines and elemental destroy Baral's thopters.
events.quote: A trio of vines leapt up from the neighboring streets, raining debris.

events.summary: Baral and Baan escape the failed trap in a thopter, and the Consulate's next phase begins.
events.quote: High above them, the black specks of thopters lifted from the decks of Skysovereign .

events.summary: Gideon is stomped by a Gearhulk, survives, and climbs it to survey the battle.
events.quote: "It's all right," he called, with forced cheer. "I'm indestructible."

events.summary: Liliana rots a living-wood Gearhulk to pieces.
events.quote: She snapped her fingers, and the Gearhulk fell to pieces at her feet.

events.summary: Gideon drops into a Gearhulk's gears and wrecks it from inside; Shadowblayde's crew rescues him.
events.quote: He looked into the gap between the armor, took a few rapid breaths, and dropped into the gears.

events.summary: Gideon sees Consulate thopters approaching the Hub and rushes back.
events.quote: "Get back to the Hub!" he shouted, breaking into a run.

events.summary: Baral confronts Chandra and Nissa on a rooftop; Nissa fights his automatons with a sword and Baral nearly kills Chandra with his blade.
events.quote: The blade falls.

events.summary: Thopter lightning strikes Mrs. Pashiri on the Hub platform after Baral orders the lifecrafter taken out.
events.quote: Mrs. Pashiri seizes and topples, smoke-colored braids flying apart.

events.summary: Baral claims he killed Kiran Nalaar and Chandra's auntie and prepares to kill Chandra; Chandra gathers superheated fire, ready to release it.
events.quote: "I killed your daddy, renegade," he says.

events.summary: Nissa embraces Chandra and talks her down from detonating, guiding her to put out the fire through a memory of floating in a quarry.
events.quote: "Don't leave us," Nissa says, softly. "You're loved."

events.summary: Nissa's elemental batters Baral, and the women escape.
events.quote: A tree slammed into him from the left.

events.summary: Baan arrests the injured Baral for murder, attempted murder, extrajudicial incarceration and falsifying records.
events.quote: Chief Inspector Dhiren Baral, I charge you with one count of murder

events.summary: Baan reports the Hub regained and leaves Baral under arrest.
events.quote: The Aether Hub has been regained.

events.summary: Gideon carries the wounded Chandra to the Heart of Kiran hanging over Weldfast, where the renegades have retreated.
events.quote: Heart of Kiran had carried the escapees from the Aether Hub to the safety of Weldfast, solidly renegade territory.

events.summary: Ajani heals Mrs. Pashiri and tells Chandra it was not her fault.
events.quote: This was not your fault, Chandra.

events.summary: Pia embraces Chandra, telling her she cannot lose her again.
events.quote: "I can't lose you again."

relations.note: Baral says he shoved a blade under Kiran's ribs.
relations.quote: When I shoved the blade under his ribs.

relations.note: Baral is called in and ordered as Tezzeret's attack dog.
Baral calls her a monster and tries to kill her.
relations.quote: So many died that day, little monster .

relations.note: Baan reports to the Grand Consul.
relations.quote: We pay you to see flaws.
I charge you with one count of murder
Pia Nalaar, partner of Kiran, mother of Chandra.
Pia Nalaar, partner of Kiran, mother of Chandra.

relations.note: Nissa says she will stand with Chandra and holds her back from destruction.
relations.quote: "I know," she says. "I'll stand with you."

relations.note: Ajani calls her Grandmother and heals her.

relations.quote: If you need someone to talk to, or just to vent at, I'm here, all right?

relations.note: She runs communications for him and rescues him.

relations.quote: now Special Grand Consul Tezzeret, endowed by the Consuls for the duration of the present crisis

relations.note: Pia commands the Hub position personally.
relations.quote: The criminal Renegade Prime commands the position personally.
